contracts.citation_semantics: Provenance validation only. Quote matching does not establish semantic entailment, completeness, evidence acceptance, compliance or truth of the attached conclusion.
contracts.quoted_vs_mapping: Citation[] carries quoted chunk-backed passages. Official mapping origins are unquoted CorpusCitation values inside Edge.citation and ProjectedLevel.sources[].citation; they retain document/page/locator and publisher metadata and must not be represented as resolved quotations.
contracts.projection_api: projectLevels(crosswalk,targetNodeIds,sourceStates,familyForFrameworkId) requires a family resolver. ProjectedLevel.version=1, kind=implementation-projection, targetFamily, suggested, confidence, reasons and structured sources.
contracts.proposal_payload: Trusted offline helper proposeCrosswalkAssessment(host,nodeId) recomputes from registry mappings/current enabled source states and stages set-level payload {nodeId,current,projection}, citations:[], confidence from canonical projection.

limitations: Resolver verifies current installed chunk provenance only; it does not reconstruct unavailable old editions or judge semantic entailment.
Existing Citation records remain loadable because new chunk fields are optional; no backfill silently upgrades legacy citations.
Whitespace differences are normalized; case and punctuation changes are rejected. Repeated quotes need disambiguating chunk/location; duplicate chunk identities fail closed.

Family-stage conversion is a conservative Visua product convention, not a publisher-certified equivalence. Missing mapping publication status stays low confidence, so some existing mappings produce no automatic proposal.
No change to licensed source data, ingest artifacts or corpus manifests. Model licensing remains a separate gate and must also be enforced at service boundary.
No full suites, browser/build, live database, deploy, Git commands or external providers executed.
integration_points: Root owns service-boundary strict-proposal validation. Call resolver for every supplied quoted citation at staging/approval and reject errors instead of trusting document membership or agent title.

Root must explicitly validate/recompute set-level payload.projection using current authoritative mapping/state/family inputs, retain mapping references separately from quotes, and prevent treating the mapping basis as observed or accepted evidence.

Root integrates these isolated changes and performs combined source review and broader required checks. Only the Citation block in shared core/types.ts belongs to this lane; concurrent AgentRun fields belong to run-reliability.
